title: Roll four dice
text: On your turn, roll four dice and split them into two pairs.

title: Climb the peaks
text: Each pair's sum moves a climber up that peak. Eleven peaks, numbered 2 to 12. You have three climbers per turn.

title: Push your luck
text: Keep rolling to climb higher, or make camp to bank your progress.

title: Avalanche!
text: If a roll can't move any of your climbers, it's an avalanche: you lose this turn's climbing.

title: Plant three flags
text: Reach a summit and make camp to plant your flag. That peak closes for everyone. First to three flags wins.
